proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10991 *laṣṭi gives Nepali lāṭho and Hindi/Bhojpuri lāṭhī stick, alongside MIA laṭṭhi. The survey laṭ(h)i/laṭṭhi forms fit the stick family; the remote lakuṭa/yaṣṭi crossing remains tentative. Exact survey form laṭi is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7627 pakṣa explicitly includes Ku. pākho roof and pā̃kh feather, plus Nepali/Bhojpuri nasal feather forms. Nasalization may reflect crossing with puṅkha. The whole pāk/pā̃kh responses fit the containing entry; n-extended pakhnā needs separate morphology. Exact survey form pãkʰ is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

The survey halka forms fit this exact branch, with intra-IA transmission unresolved. Exact survey form halkə is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
